note: Handoff to the registry verify/ASSUMPTIONS.json (owner L1). disposition prefix: owner = one of the eight; gate/fact = removed by a gate or a fact; open = neither yet.

entries.statement: The Sail x86 model (sail-x86-from-acl2 at the pinned commit, plus lift/proof/sail_patches) is the semantics of the reference CPU for every proved shape.
entries.disposition: owner: 9, pinned formal tools and published theorems (owner decision, CLAUDE.md of the trunk 55cbf861); the Sail model with the pinned patch of 5b76d567

entries.statement: isla and z3 at the pinned versions are sound: an unsat answer means no counterexample.
entries.disposition: owner: 9, pinned formal tools and published theorems (owner decision, CLAUDE.md of the trunk 55cbf861)

entries.statement: The process runs in flat 4 GiB segments, 32-bit protected mode.
entries.disposition: owner: Win32 by documentation

entries.statement: Every instruction lies at eip < 2^32 - 16.
entries.disposition: gate: checkable over the section table of every module (not yet a gate)

entries.statement: With --eip fixed: semantics is translation-invariant in eip.
entries.disposition: fact: mode to delete; A-EIPRANGE (symbolic eip) is the only product path

entries.statement: Pre-states where the model raises a segment-limit fault are excluded; the lifted code wraps modulo 2^32.
entries.disposition: owner: no wild accesses, for data; relative branch targets are checked by proof/symcheck.py (make it a gate)

entries.statement: Decoding (operand structure, family) is a function of the shape: masked imm/disp fields never change it.
entries.disposition: gate: same decoder-agreement gate, run on every occurrence (not the representative): operand structure of each occurrence equals that of its shape

entries.statement: capstone decodes every x86 instruction of the universe to its true length, fields and operands.
entries.disposition: gate: agreement of independent decoders (capstone, LLVM MC, XED) on every byte of the code ranges of the exe and modules; any difference is red (orchestrator decision 2026-11-11)

entries.statement: capstone group tags classify the instruction-set extension of a form correctly.
entries.disposition: gate: same decoder-agreement gate, extension class compared with XED isa-set on every instruction

entries.statement: For shapes outside the Sail model (x87 control/state, cpuid, rdtsc, part of SIMD: 7 019 shapes have no DSL builder yet) the reference is a transcription of the SDM compared with the host.
entries.disposition: open: no machine reference yet; host comparison is exhaustive only for 16/32-bit input spaces

entries.statement: 17 (mnemonic, undefined flag) pairs: the value the reference CPU produces is not yet pinned.
entries.disposition: open: needs the reference-CPU table (same host as rcp), then a fact

entries.statement: No x87/SSE exception is ever unmasked (I-FPMASK); fwait and FP arithmetic never raise.
entries.disposition: fact: every control-word write (fldcw, ldmxcsr, fninit, frstor, fldenv, fxrstor, _controlfp/_control87 with operand) found statically and proved to keep the masks; if not proved, exact unmasked-exception semantics before the first frame (orchestrator decision 2026-11-11; owner of the work L3b)

entries.statement: Test harness only: sticky flags not observed (I-FPSTICKY set in instest ASSUME).
entries.disposition: fact: test-only; product path maintains the flags

entries.statement: GCC keeps an FP operation before the FPSR read that follows it in program order (GCC has no FENV_ACCESS).
entries.disposition: open: not compiler correctness: GCC is allowed to reorder. Closing rule: FPSR read through an operation the compiler must order (asm with FP operand dependency), then gate on objects

entries.statement: Host code between guest instructions (imports, native bodies) runs with the guest FPSR parked or raises nothing the guest sees.
entries.disposition: gate: rt/imp.h parks FPSR on imports; native bodies need the same by rule (L2/L3a)

entries.statement: A handler resuming by ContinueExecution does not change the FP flag owner nor leave the x87/MMX register file in another carrier format.
entries.disposition: open: closable by canonicalising on resume in rt/seh.cc (L3a)

entries.statement: An MMX read of a register popped by a static-stack function, with no MMX write since, reads data undefined on the CPU too.
entries.disposition: open: the CPU value is defined (old bits); closing = write back on pop or prove no such read statically

entries.statement: fnsave stores the real indefinite for an empty register; fldenv/frstor treat an empty-tagged register per the tag only.
entries.disposition: open: the CPU stores the kept 80-bit image; fv_free keeps it, so this can be made exact and the assumption removed

entries.statement: ES (bit 7) and B (bit 15) of FSW are 0.
entries.disposition: fact: follows the A-FPMASK fact, or is implemented with the unmasked semantics

entries.statement: FDP after an instruction without memory operand is unchanged (SDM leaves it unspecified).
entries.disposition: open: pin to the reference CPU by a host table, then fact

entries.statement: FDS is DS whenever FDP != 0 (FS-relative operand reported with DS).
entries.disposition: open: wrong for FS operands on the CPU; closing = keep the selector per operand (1 store)

entries.statement: FOP is recomputed from the opcode bytes at FIP when an image is written.
entries.disposition: fact: code is read-only (W^X of the lifted image) so the bytes are those executed; needs the read-only fact from L3a universe

entries.statement: Reserved bits of the fnstenv/fnsave image are 0.
entries.disposition: open: pin to the reference CPU by host comparison (exhaustive over the state that feeds them)

entries.statement: fbld with a nibble above 9 gives the arithmetic sum nibble*10^i (SDM: undefined).
entries.disposition: open: pin to the reference CPU; per-digit-position independence would make a host table exhaustive

entries.statement: x87 values and flags are those of binary32/binary64 arithmetic of the source types, not 80-bit.
entries.disposition: owner: IEEE

entries.statement: Every callee (direct, indirect, import) pops esp as its RETN says and preserves ebp; stack coordinates survive a call.
entries.disposition: fact: stack delta and ebp/esp restore checked from the exe code for every function at every ret; a function without the fact gets the conservative (ORDERED) class (orchestrator decision 2026-11-11)

entries.statement: No guest access straddles address 2^32 (the compiler may narrow M64(a)>>32 to a load at a+4 in 64-bit arithmetic).
entries.disposition: owner: no wild accesses

entries.statement: Only instructions of the lifter decode transfer control (constant-address proof for lock/xchg within a block).
entries.disposition: gate: universe closure gate of L3a

entries.statement: A stack slot at a proved coordinate of a frame whose address does not escape is accessed by its thread only (class PLAIN).
entries.disposition: gate: escape analysis is in memclass; verify_r9 (deferred until first frame) is the independent check

entries.statement: The mapping x86-TSO -> Armv8 (ordered load = ldar or load+dmb ishld, ordered store = stlr or dmb ishst+store, locked RMW = exclusive pair/CAS + dmb ish) preserves every x86-TSO behaviour bound.
entries.disposition: owner: 9, pinned formal tools and published theorems (owner decision, CLAUDE.md of the trunk 55cbf861)

entries.statement: rt/rcptab.cert.json was produced by farm/rcpcert.sh on a CPU with the reference identity.
entries.disposition: fact: hash of the certificate is kept in the store (orchestrator: not an assumption)

entries.statement: RCPSS/RSQRTSS are pure functions of the input bits: MXCSR does not influence them.
entries.disposition: open: checked on 20e6 inputs x 8 MXCSR values = sampling. Closing: rerun the 2^32 sweep under each MXCSR RC/FTZ/DAZ combination on the farm (8 x 189 s)

entries.statement: capstone decodes every AArch64 instruction of an object to its architectural id; unmarked sections are code from their start.
entries.disposition: gate: agreement of capstone and LLVM MC on every instruction of every object of ours; any difference is red (orchestrator decision 2026-11-11)

entries.statement: The helpers sse_f2i and fv_i are correct (range guard, rounding mode, integer indefinite).
entries.disposition: gate: forms: fpexact is green only if forms is green on the same helpers

entries.statement: An object and its .f2i.json come from the same compile.
entries.disposition: gate: recipe cache key binds both once the plugin is a recipe stage

entries.statement: An inline asm without FP/vector operand and without FP clobber does no float->int conversion.
entries.disposition: gate: check 3b covers units with no site; closing fully = forbid inline asm outside listed rt files by the plugin

entries.statement: No float->int conversion of a C literal occurs in lifted code (GCC folds an out-of-range constant to the saturated value, not the x86 indefinite).
entries.disposition: gate: closable in the plugin: constant operand of a conversion = finding

entries.statement: Native bodies compiled with fnvnx_ftoi are judged by L2 rules, not by fpexact.
entries.disposition: gate: L2 gate

entries.statement: Every guest thread starts with FCW 0x027F and MXCSR 0x1F80.
entries.disposition: fact: set by the runtime at thread entry (rt/enter.cc); being verified against the code with the FP-mask fact

entries.statement: An imported system function changes the x87/SSE control state only if it is a control import (_controlfp, _control87, _fpreset).
entries.disposition: owner: 3, Win32 and CRT as documented, plus the runtime import bodies

entries.statement: The CONTEXT image handed to guest SEH handlers is only read back by the runtime restore, which restores a reachable control state.
entries.disposition: open: a handler may write the FP control words in CONTEXT; being checked against rt/seh.cc with the FP-mask fact

not_mine.statement: TAB_BIAS = 16: lowest index of a jump table is below 16
A8: handler changes to the CONTEXT of a native frame do not reach native state
